verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents a REST API with a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec (61 paths), a JavaScript SDK, and a CLI. Machine creation is explicitly available through the console, API, or CLI. However, nothing in the evidence claims or shows that the API matches the UI across all features: notebooks, deployments, workflows, team user management, snapshots and auto-shutdown are documented without stating API coverage. Missing for 10: an explicit UI–API parity statement, documented API coverage of notebooks, deployments, workflows, user access, templates and auto-shutdown, and independent hands-on confirmation of full parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: You can create a Linux machine using the Paperspace console, Paperspace API, or Paperspace CLI.
Programmatically manage Paperspace resources using conventional HTTP requests.
The production API domain serves a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.3 document at /v1/openapi.json
API keys let you interact with Paperspace through the Core RESTful API, the Core JavaScript SDK, and Gradient command-line utility (CLI).
